div.div:
Notes
*1 An FSx for ONTAP destination always needs an agent and
Basic mode
Agentless Enhanced mode applies only when the destination
is Amazon S3
*2 Staging through S3 makes both legs agentless
In exchange you pay for S3 staging and transfer twice.
Which wins flips with volume and duration
*3 Collaboration SaaS is out of scope for this figure
Box / Dropbox / OneDrive / Google Drive are not DataSync
sources (group B)
